value.data: Exceptional residential project in prominent Koramangala. Strategically connected to NH 44 and Hosur Road, offering unparalleled accessibility.. Configurations: 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 4 BHK, 5 BHK

Residents generally express satisfaction with the luxurious amenities, robust security, and excellent connectivity of K Raheja Vivarea, appreciating its prime location and well-designed apartments. However, some concerns have been raised regarding construction delays and the high pricing of the units.
